rules.title: Debug mode enabled
rules.description: Debug mode leaks stack traces, configuration and source. Flask's debugger additionally exposes an interactive Python console reachable over HTTP.
rules.remediation: Drive it from an environment variable that defaults to off.

rules.title: Service bound to 0.0.0.0
rules.description: Binding every interface exposes the service beyond the intended network unless a firewall covers for it. Inside a container this is often correct; on a host it is the difference between a local service and a public one.
rules.remediation: Bind 127.0.0.1 and put a reverse proxy in front, or bind the specific private interface.

rules.title: Django SECRET_KEY hardcoded
rules.description: SECRET_KEY signs sessions and password-reset tokens. Anyone with it can forge a session for any user.
rules.remediation: Read it from the environment and rotate the leaked value.

rules.title: Session cookie without Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite
rules.description: Without HttpOnly, any XSS reads the session cookie. Without Secure, it travels over plaintext. SameSite=None without care re-opens CSRF.
rules.remediation: Set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax (or Strict) on session cookies.

rules.title: CSRF protection disabled
rules.description: Without CSRF protection, a third-party page can make an authenticated state-changing request on a logged-in user's behalf.
rules.remediation: Keep the framework's CSRF middleware on. For APIs that genuinely do not need it, require a non-simple content type and an Authorization header instead of cookies.

rules.title: Content-Security-Policy set to a permissive value
rules.description: unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval remove most of what a CSP is for.
rules.remediation: Use nonces or hashes for the scripts you actually need; drop unsafe-eval entirely.

rules.title: Container image runs as root
rules.description: A process running as uid 0 inside the container turns a container escape or a writable mount into host-level access.
rules.remediation: Create an unprivileged user and switch to it as the final USER instruction.

rules.title: Base image pinned to :latest or unpinned
rules.description: An unpinned base image means the contents of your build change without the build changing - including security-relevant contents.
rules.remediation: Pin to a digest, or at minimum an immutable version tag.
owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

rules.title: curl piped into a shell
rules.description: Whatever that host serves at build time is executed with full privileges, with no verification and no record of what ran.
rules.remediation: Download to a file, verify a checksum or signature, then execute.
owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

rules.title: Kubernetes container running privileged or as root
rules.description: A privileged container has effectively the same access as a root process on the node.
rules.remediation: Drop all capabilities, set runAsNonRoot: true and allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.

rules.title: Storage bucket or security group open to the world
rules.description: An anonymous-readable bucket or a security group open to 0.0.0.0/0 removes the network boundary entirely.
rules.remediation: Scope the CIDR to known ranges; keep buckets private and serve through signed URLs or a CDN.

rules.title: IAM policy granting Action: *
rules.description: A wildcard action or resource grants far more than the workload needs, which is what turns a small compromise into a large one.
rules.remediation: Enumerate the actions and ARNs the role actually uses.
